Maya Patel: Heads-up — I noticed the Optimize toolkit 'prefetch policy' section is ambiguous vs the Go/Python SDK examples. The current prose implies prefetch always helps when in reality it only triggers with a cache TTL > 0. Link: https://go.redwood/example-prefetch (screenshot in thread). Planning a tiny docs PR to: 1) clarify when prefetch runs, 2) show minimal Go + Python examples, 3) add a short migration note. Anyone already on this?
Jonah Li: I started a draft PR for the Go SDK change earlier but it's blocked on unit tests flaking on CI (PR #4826). I can drop the SDK snippet update if docs wants to keep the original example until tests are stable.
Samira Ahmed: @Jonah please don't leave the snippet misleading — it's causing support tickets. Quick repro: the Go snippet currently shows `Batcher{MaxBatch:16, Prefetch:true}` — that suggests Prefetch=true is sufficient. It's not. Prefetch will no-op unless cache TTL > 0.
Samira Ahmed: Suggested doc snippet for clarity (minimal):
```go
// enable k-v prefetch: set cache TTL and prefetch flag
client.OptimizeConfig = OptimizeConfig{
  Batcher: BatcherOptions{MaxBatch: 16},
  Cache: CacheOptions{TTLSeconds: 60, Prefetch: true},
}
```
Ben Clarkson: I can take the docs PR. Plan: small migration note 'upgrade: ensure cache TTL > 0 to activate prefetch' + both Go/Python examples and one-line troubleshooting tip. Will also add a short note about how prefetch interacts with continuous batching.
Jonah Li: Thanks @Ben — I'll rebase my SDK PR after tests. For docs I can add a unit-test-compatible snippet (no env deps) if that helps.
DocsBot: Automated note: linked issue #2017 -> created PR redwood/docs#4830 by Ben Clarkson. CI: docs-lint passed.
Maya Patel: Perfect — Ben, can you include a tiny table: 'Setting' vs 'Effect' (e.g., Prefetch:true + TTL>0 => prefetches prefixes; Prefetch:true + TTL=0 => no prefetch). Keep it one paragraph + code examples. Target to merge by EOD tomorrow? :thumbsup:
Ben Clarkson: Yup will send draft in ~2 hours, ping me if you want a longer migration playbook.
Samira Ahmed: Quick note for the reviewers: add a test case to the SDK repo asserting that Prefetch with TTL=0 doesn't call the backend prefetch path. Saves future confusion.
Maya Patel: Thanks team — assigning to Ben for docs PR and to Jonah for SDK follow-up. Marking this thread resolved when docs PR merges. :white_check_mark:
